policyDefinitions.P0-binary: Main location+any movement; otherwise Additional; all ties retained
policyDefinitions.P1-main-pareto: Axis-capped Pareto frontier within Main, otherwise Additional; strict Main priority
policyDefinitions.P2-union-guard: P1 plus union frontier if any Additional is not dominated by every Main frontier member
policyDefinitions.P3-protected-union: P1 plus undominated Additional candidates, but never silently drop the Main frontier

benchmarks.purpose: upper/lateral single-leg: medius and minimus separation
upper/lateral leg-out: medius/minimus natural tie
upper/lateral stand-up: location versus glute max movement
upper/lateral extension plus abduction: cross-group
upper/lateral stairs: compound action
upper/lateral knee bend: no invented glute evidence
center stand-up: glute max versus deep reference
center leg-back: hip extension relation
center single-leg: lateral glute candidates
center leg-side: lateral action does not diagnose piriformis
center knee bend: hamstring not promoted by unrelated location
center stairs and single-leg: glute overlap
lower knee bend: proximal hamstring
lower leg-back: hamstring versus glute max
lower stand-up: shared extension
lower stairs: shared extension
lower knee bend plus leg-back: same-axis and knee evidence
lower leg-side: no forced top muscle
unknown location: do not infer anatomy
unknown movement: do not infer action
center triple extension: axis cap
upper triple lateral/extension: Pareto tradeoff
mirror of BUT-001
lower bilateral: avoid unilateral inference

optionalCrossLeg.rationale: Crossing legs is posture, not a direction-controlled isolation test; cannot uniquely identify piriformis from these answers.
